description:
Froststrap is a fork of Bloxstrap and Fishstrap, focused on performance and customization.


Froststrap 2.0.2 - What's new?
Fixed
- Updater mishap where it's looking for an MSI package on the releases for windows
- macOS URI handling- now actually launches it
- macOS Notification stuff not asking for permission sometimes
- GBS setting duplication
Added
- Window manipulation has more edge-cases
Codebase
- Some refactoring taken place in Mod Generator
- Linux .desktop registration isn't handled on runtime now
- Paths.Application completely refactored out to reduce bugs
Full Changelog: v2.0.1...v2.0.2
